title: The hard problem recast as the body-body problem

statements.text: Substituting the body for the physical, the question becomes how a physical living body (Körper) is also a lived body (Leib). These are two modes of appearance of one body, so the gap lies within one typology of living being and is no longer absolute.

sources.quote: It’s tempting to call this problem the body–body problem.
this gap is no longer absolute, because in order to state it we need to make common reference on both sides to life or living being
